build_multi_backbone: build a MultiBackbone module with multiple backbone configs and feature aggregation MLP layers
create_backbone_list: create a ModuleList of backbones from a list or dict of backbone configuration objects
test_forward_pass: test the MultiBackbone forward pass with point cloud tensor input and verify aggregated hd_feature output
review_aggregation_layers: review the MultiBackbone aggregation layers that concatenate and reduce features from multiple backbones
refactor_init_weights: refactor the MultiBackbone init_weights method to load pretrained checkpoint weights with non-strict matching
